title: [finding] `FieldSchema.scale` on a `currency` field is offered to authors by the field designer, ignored by every display face, and still enforced on writes — half-live in the direction that surprises
body:
Filed at 2026-09-22T02:11Z by the `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917), from the
`out_of_scope_findings` of the #19579 round, marked **class (c)** by the dev. ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no
`priority:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

⭐ **This card exists because a ruling said it must.** Ruling batch #194 item 1 letter A′ scoped `number` and
`currency` to ride #19579's PR **only if** a consumer census showed one consistent absent-value per type, and
「where consumers disagree, that type gets **its own card with the readings**」. The `currency` census came back
**inconsistent**. ⇒ this is that card, with those readings.

## The defect, in one sentence

`FieldSchema.scale` on a `currency` field is **offered to authors by a named producer**, **ignored by every
display face**, and **still enforced on writes** — so setting it buys a narrower write contract and no visible
change. Half-live, in the direction that **surprises** rather than refuses.

## ⏱️ Readings — attributed, ⛔ NOT re-taken by this seat

⚠️ Every leg below is the #19579 dev's, taken at objectui `origin/main` `0cf2d6644b` and re-read identically
at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `87af769e9a`. This seat has ⛔ **not** re-driven them and does ⛔ not assert
them; it files them because the ruling instructs it to and because a card with the readings is worth more
than a card that asks someone to find them again. **Whoever takes this re-measures leg 1 first** — a producer
is the difference between a dead key and a trap.

**Leg 1 — the producer is named, and it is stored metadata, ⛔ not a React prop.** The metadata-admin field
designer ships a `scale` control:
`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:907-909` —
`label={tr('designer.field.scale')}`, `onCommit={(v) => patchDef({ scale: v })}`, with the label declared in
`i18n.ts:1477` / `:3448`. ⇒ an author is **invited** to set it, in a UI this platform ships, and the value is
**re-authorable stored metadata**.

**Leg 2 — no display face reads it on a currency field.** `CurrencyCellRenderer` formats through
`formatCurrency(value, currency, locale)` and passes **no** scale; `packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`
reads `precision` and says so in-line (「No `scale` passed: this is a currency widget whose `precision` is a …」);
fraction digits otherwise come from the currency's own **ISO 4217 minor-unit count**.

**Leg 3 — the write path DOES enforce it.** `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:789-812`
enforces `max_scale` on a currency write from that same declaration. ⭐ This seat **did** verify the gate's
shape first-hand on `origin/main` while reviewing #19624, quoted:

```
if (
  def.scale !== undefined &&
  Number.isInteger(def.scale) &&
  def.scale >= 0
) {
```

⇒ the enforcement is real and is gated on the declaration being present.

## ⇒ The observable consequence

An author sets `scale: 3` on a currency field in the designer and gets:

- **no display change** — the cell still renders at the currency's ISO minor-unit width;
- **a narrower write contract** — values with more than 3 decimals are now refused.

⚠️ ⛔ Nothing tells them either fact. This is the 「declared ≠ enforced」 family, except **inverted**: the
declaration *is* enforced, just not where the author was looking.

## Why a guessed default is refused here

The ruling names it: a global `0` would turn an undeclared currency from **`$25.00` into `$25`**, which is
exactly why plain letter **A** was refused. ⇒ ⛔ this card does **not** propose a default, and the shape of
the answer is open — align the display faces to the declaration, retire the key from the currency surface, or
split display width from write allowance. ⛔ This card states no preference.

## Seam

`spec:FieldSchema.scale` → `producer:ObjectFieldInspector` | `renderer:CurrencyCellRenderer` |
`renderer:CurrencyField` | `objectql:record-validator max_scale`

## Why it lands in THIS repo

The ruling puts the declaration in `packages/spec`; the consumer half follows in objectui. 〈多仓协调〉rule 1:
「issue 住在修复落地的仓」.

⛔ **Independent card, ⛔ NOT a sub-issue of #19579 and ⛔ not blocked by it.** ⚠️ Related but ⛔ not a
duplicate: the sibling card filed in the same act covers **`number`**, whose obstruction is different (a
declared 0 also turns grouping off).

## Dedupe

`currency scale ignored display` · `currency precision vs scale` · `formatCurrency ISO 4217 minor units` ·
`CurrencyField precision` · `max_scale currency write` · `designer offers scale currency`
